items.name: CustomMetricValue
items.signature: trait CustomMetricValue: Display + Debug + Send + Sync
items.summary: A trait for implementing custom metric values.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.summary: Merges another metric value into this one.

methods.name: as_any
methods.summary: Returns this value as a [`Any`] to support dynamic downcasting.

methods.name: as_usize
methods.summary: Optionally returns a numeric representation of the value, if meaningful. Otherwise will default to zero.

methods.name: is_eq
methods.summary: Compares this value with another custom value.

methods.name: new_empty
methods.summary: Returns a new, zero-initialized version of this metric value.
